name: Vampire High School
original_name: バンパイアハイすく～る
source:
Kerotan is a teacher in girls high school and he's always having troubles of students actions. One day student council president purchased an original coffin from Romania. After that the behavior of some students got strange and two scratches on the neck of professors got itchy. Perhaps students can explain what's going on.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
凯洛坦是女子高中的一名教师，总是被学生们的举动弄得焦头烂额。一天，学生会长买来一具产自罗马尼亚的真正棺材。此后，部分学生的行为开始变得古怪，凯洛坦脖子上的两道抓痕也隐隐发痒。也许，学生们能解释究竟发生了什么。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
